predeclared_gate.decision: No endpoint reached the predeclared common-usable minimum; no endpoint-level native-resolution requirement is promoted from this 32-photo gate.

fine_architecture.interpretation: Original resolution increased eligibility descriptively, but there were no common-usable pairs for numeric comparability.

surface.interpretation: Original resolution increased eligibility descriptively, but there were no common-usable pairs for numeric comparability.

next_step.action: Run the same no-retention stream design on a 128-photo deterministic prefix to raise common-usable counts for primary colour, outline and orientation endpoints; retain fine-geometry eligibility as a separate technical question.
next_step.not_required: No permanent original-image archive or external 1.5-TB storage path is required for this follow-up.

limits: This is a deterministic technical pilot, not a representative ecological cohort.
A medium/original difference combines server-side resizing, JPEG encoding, detector localization and feature extraction.
No source image bytes are retained; hashes and numerical outputs do not establish physical accuracy.
A flagged endpoint justifies a larger streamed native-resolution test, not a 1.5-TB archive.
